businesses.business: IT management and security software for managed service providers

offering_description.value: Develops and sells cloud-based software platforms for remote monitoring and management, security, data protection, and service automation. Customers are mainly managed service providers (MSPs) and IT departments of small and mid-sized businesses. Delivered as software-as-a-service.

primary_products.value: remote monitoring and management software; endpoint detection and response security software; backup and data protection software; email security; documentation and PSA tools

customer_segment.value: B2B: managed service providers, IT service firms and internal IT teams of small and mid-sized enterprises

end_markets.value: managed IT services; cybersecurity; small and mid-sized business IT

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring SaaS subscriptions priced per device, user or endpoint managed

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops cloud software platforms sold to MSPs who resell to end customers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions through MSP customers in about 100 countries

specialization.value: related lines: remote management, security, data protection and ticketing tools for MSPs

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales team selling to MSPs and enterprises; online: web-based trials and purchases; partners / resellers: channel partners and distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: low: data privacy and security rules such as GDPR, no licensing needed to sell software
